tasks.label: gigalixir-status
tasks.command: cmd /c "cd /d c:\software\psc-elixir && (if exist tmp\agent-logs\deploy.log (echo === deploy.log size === && for %F in (tmp\agent-logs\deploy.log) do @echo %~zF bytes && echo === tail === && more +0 tmp\agent-logs\deploy.log) else (echo no deploy.log)) > tmp\agent-logs\status.log 2>&1 && git status --short --branch >> tmp\agent-logs\status.log 2>&1 && git --no-pager log --oneline -3 >> tmp\agent-logs\status.log 2>&1"
